import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class E1 {
    public E1() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        ArrayList<Integer> V = new ArrayList<>(), K = new ArrayList<>(), X = new ArrayList<>();
        char[] s = sc.next().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'V')
                V.add(i);
            else if (s[i] == 'K')
                K.add(i);
            else
                X.add(i);
        }
        long[][][][] dp = new long[n + 1][n + 1][n + 1][2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < 2; d++)
                        dp[i][j][k][d] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v <= V.size(); v++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= K.size(); k++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= X.size(); x++) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                        long cur = dp[v][k][x][t];
                        if (v < V.size()) {
                            int vv = V.get(v);
                            int m1 = rem(V, v, vv) + rem(K, k, vv) + rem(X, x, vv);
                            dp[v + 1][k][x][1] = Math.min(dp[v + 1][k][x][1], cur + m1);
                        }
                        if (k < K.size() && t == 0) {
                            int kk = K.get(k);
                            int m2 = rem(V, v, kk) + rem(K, k, kk) + rem(X, x, kk);
                            dp[v][k + 1][x][0] = Math.min(dp[v][k + 1][x][0], cur + m2);
                        }
                        if (x < X.size()) {
                            int xx = X.get(x);
                            int m3 = rem(V, v, xx) + rem(K, k, xx) + rem(X, x, xx);
                            dp[v][k][x + 1][0] = Math.min(dp[v][k][x + 1][0], cur + m3);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        long ret = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            ret = Math.min(ret, dp[V.size()][K.size()][X.size()][i]);
        out.println(ret);
        sc.close();
        out.close();
    }

    private int rem(ArrayList<Integer> arr, int ind, int val) {
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = ind; i < arr.size() && arr.get(i) < val; i++)
            cnt++;
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new E1();
    }
}
